kind: Parent-produced hand-written Wasm experiment; not Scheme extern support, gcbench retention proof, or timing.
findings: Typed GC struct/array JS calls pass raw/optimized checks and reject invalid returns.
A separate Wasm provider links for the tested typed layouts with and without closed-world optimization.
Pure allocations move after collection if only consumed afterward; before/after opaque calls pin the tested references across collection.
limitations: No general GC-reference ABI or compiler feature is implemented.
Closed-world optimizer contracts and reachable-layout preservation require separate review.
No proof of intended gcbench lifetime on strict or Chez.
retained_failed_attempt: Initial --all-features assembly output fails Node validation; successful runs use project feature flags.
